notes.P04: Independently rolling services may still require customer_id; issuing key-only tokens before they are upgraded breaks authentication/identity handling.
notes.P06: The partner still requires customer_id and cannot handle customer_key-only events until its next release window.
notes.P08: A key-only cache cutover drops support for v1 numeric invalidations while v1 shares Redis, risking stale data after writes.
notes.P10: v1 can still create NULL-key rows during the rollback window, so NOT NULL can break writes and prematurely block rollback.
notes.P12: Removing customer_id before the contractual one-release compatibility window ends breaks old REST clients.
notes.P14: Generating an unpersisted fresh UUID per read makes the identity unstable, violating the requirement that customer_key never change.
